question: What is the rated capacity in MW of the Viking Link interconnector between Denmark and Great Britain?
caveat: This is the rated capacity; actual available transfer can be lower depending on operating and grid conditions.

sources.quote: Viking Link is a 1400 MW high voltage direct current (HVDC) interconnector, connecting the transmission systems of Great Britain (GB) and Denmark (DK).
Project Detail Value/Technology Unit Rated Capacity 1400 MW

The current capacity of the Viking Link varies between 1,100 MW and 1,400 MW depending on conditions in the onshore grid. The top limit cannot now always be met, because onshore grid in the Western part of Jutland is being reinforced. Looking ahead, the Viking Link is expected to reach its full capacity of 1,400 MW in 2026, once the Danish electricity grid is fully prepared.
